import json
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

training_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo384.json')
guard_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo384_memory.json')
prior_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo192.json')
prior_completion = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo192_completion.json')
training, guard, prior, completed = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in
                                    (training_path, guard_path, prior_path, prior_completion)]
root = Path('train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-rloo384')
adapter = root / 'adapters.safetensors'
checkpoints = list(root.glob('step_*'))
assert training['status'] == guard['status'] == 'completed'
assert len(training['history']) == 384 and training['initial_completed_groups'] == 192
assert training['history'][:192] == prior['history']
assert len(checkpoints) == 1 and checkpoints[0].name == 'step_0384'
assert file_sha256(adapter) == file_sha256(checkpoints[0] / 'adapters.safetensors')
r = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain the final fixed local budget before policy validation'}, training['model_revision']),
     'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'status': 'completed',
     'groups_completed_total':384, 'groups_completed_before_segment':192, 'new_groups':192,
     'training_segment_wall_seconds':training['wall_seconds'],
     'prior_training_wall_seconds':completed['training_chain_wall_seconds'],
     'training_chain_wall_seconds':training['wall_seconds']+completed['training_chain_wall_seconds'],
     'mlx_allocated_peak_bytes':training['peak_memory_bytes'],
     'sampled_footprint_peak_bytes_approx':guard['sampled_footprint_peak_bytes_approx'],
     'initial_history_preserved':True, 'latest_resume_checkpoint':str(checkpoints[0]),
     'checkpoint_retention_verified':True,
     'retained_adapter_optimizer_bytes':sum(p.stat().st_size for p in root.rglob('*.safetensors')),
     'adapter_sha256':file_sha256(adapter),
     'input_sha256':{str(p):file_sha256(p) for p in (training_path,guard_path,prior_path,prior_completion,adapter)},
     'interpretation':'192 new groups resume the fixed RLOO192 adapter and Adam state. All 192 prior history entries match exactly, and previous frozen weights remain intact. Completion establishes no validation improvement.'}
Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo384_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print({k:r[k] for k in ('new_groups','training_segment_wall_seconds','training_chain_wall_seconds','mlx_allocated_peak_bytes')})
